item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong 2024 evidence on anti-graft enforcement, but not credible evidence that Trọng had a family-based patronage network or that he personally used business partners for enrichment. The strongest “no” evidence is indirect: major fraud/capture persisted, the anti-graft drive destabilized administration, and the campaign did not produce a clean, depoliticized market order. After July 18, 2024, Trọng’s effective direct control ended, so late-2024 anti-graft outcomes are only indirectly attributable to him.","evidence":[]}
